description: Discover the best hotels in Koh Samui, Thailand. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Five-Star Koh Samui Hilltop Escape with All-Pool Villas
hotels.description: A secluded slice of serenity awaits at the hilltop hideaway of Banyan Tree Samui, a five-star pool-villa resort ranked #4 among resorts in Lamai Beach on Koh Samui by Tripadvisor. Here you'll discover true bliss in the form of a private villa with infinity pool overlooking spectacular garden and ocean scenes, an award-winning day spa with 10 treatment rooms, three superb restaurants, and laidback lounge and pool bars. Unwind by your private pool, watching the palm trees sway in the sea breeze. For a touch of self-care, head to the Yoga Centre for complimentary stretching and sun salutations, cosy up in the library and games room with a good book or take the little ones to the fun-filled Kids' Club for arts and crafts, games, and traditional Thai dance classes. When you're ready to head out and explore, the buzzing centre of Lamai Beach, home to restaurants, beach bars and shops, is only a 15-minute drive away. Travel a few minutes further to Fisherman's Village with its boutique cafés, shops and famous night market which backs onto Koh Samui's most famous beach, Bophut Beach, or head to Namuang Waterfalls, a set of two cascades that plummet into a refreshing natural swimming hole

hotels.title: Award-Winning Koh Samui Beachfront Bliss
hotels.description: Discover the true meaning of Thai luxury with an escape to Buri Rasa Village Samui, awarded the Best Luxury Beach Hotel and Best Luxury Boutique Resort - Continent Winner at the REVE Luxury Awards 2025. Perched on the pristine sands of Chaweng, on the east coastline of Koh Samui, this boutique resort offers the best of everything, with lapping crystal-clear waters, lush tropical greenery and vibrant nightlife all just seconds away. Rooms and suites combine traditional southern Thai architecture with contemporary luxury to encourage beachfront bliss from the moment you walk in. Once you’ve explored every indulgent detail, set up for a day of sunshine by the slate-sided pool or white sands of Chaweng Beach, with a soundtrack of lapping water and refreshments courtesy of the Beach Bar. When hunger strikes, venture to the oceanfront Beach Club restaurant, where sensational seafood is transformed into modern Thai dishes, served alongside a selection of wines from the old and new world. When you’re ready to be pampered, Nam Thai Herbal Spa is home to one-of-a-kind treatments in a lush tropical setting, dialling up the relaxation levels to ‘heavenly’.

hotels.title: Extended by Popular Demand: Koh Samui Private Island Pool Villas with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Dinner
hotels.description: Check-in to a pool villa only moments from the shores of Koh Samui, yet a million miles from everyday life. A tranquil treasure dropped in the ocean just off Choeng Mon Beach, this private island resort promises white sands, unparalleled sunsets and crystal-clear waters. This multi-award-winning five-star hotel boasts an in-house spa surrounded by greenery, a sprawling main pool and a fine dining restaurant by world-renowned Australian chef, David Thompson. Lose track of time playing games under the pavilion while sipping a complimentary nightly cocktail, or see the island from a different perspective by booking in a luxury yacht charter. When you're not lounging on the island's secluded beach backed by lush trees and local birdsong, enjoy your choice of lunch or dinner at Hue, where a choice of Thai or international set menus is sure to satisfy. If romance is what you seek, talk to the staff about an intimate dinner on the beach, or simply retreat to your private pool and watch the sun set over the Gulf of Thailand.

hotels.title: Thailand All-Inclusive Luxury: Koh Samui Beachfront Escape with Massages & Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Escape to all-inclusive paradise on the tranquil southern shores of Koh Samui at Centara Villas Samui, spectacularly set on a stretch of pristine beachfront. Spend your days surrounded by lush tropical gardens sipping free-flow cocktails by any of the resort's three pools, kayak or paddleboard on the brilliant blues of the Andaman Sea or retreat to your own private tropical villa. Head to Reef Café for authentic Thai dishes and international favourites, Papillon Lounge for refreshing cocktails and light refreshments or Coral Bar for beach barbecues by the sea. Perfectly balancing seclusion and convenience, this serene retreat is close to the island’s dining, shopping and nightlife, with a daily shuttle on offer for an additional cost.

hotels.title: Koh Samui All-Inclusive Oceanfront Luxury with Massages & Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Step into the lobby and immediately feel transported to a new world at Hyatt Regency Koh Samui, a jewel on the island's eastern coast overlooking the Gulf of Thailand. The interiors are modern and minimalistic, elevated by artistic design that draws your eye to endless ocean views. Five freeform pools cascade down the hillside to a private stretch of beach while more than 600 protected Yang Na and coconut trees create a secluded sanctuary, far removed from the outside world. For families, Camp Hyatt is the beating heart of the resort, offering a packed schedule of activities for little ones so parents can unwind knowing the kids are in great hands. Mornings begin at Yangna restaurant with an international buffet infused with local Thai flavours. As the day fades, head to KUBE - the resort's highest point - for sunset, before meandering down the winding paths to SESUN Grill & Beach Bar: a kaleidoscope of colour set on golden sands, pairing fresh seafood and bold Thai flavours to make dinner an occasion rather than an afterthought. Take a dip in the adults-only pool or head to Veriō Spa, where holistic treatments restore body, mind and spirit. With all-inclusive dining and unlimited drinks, your stay is guaranteed to be as seamless as it is indulgent. From paddleboarding and kayaking to snorkelling the crystal-clear Gulf waters and daily soft serve ice cream, there's no shortage of adventures, and sweet treats, for the whole family to share.

hotels.title: Koh Samui Five-Star Boutique Beachside Retreat with Six Infinity Pools
hotels.description: Step onto sun-kissed sands, feel the salt breeze on your face and savour every moment of serenity when you escape to the boutique, five-star InterContinental Koh Samui Resort, dramatically positioned on jungled hilltops overlooking the dazzling Gulf of Thailand. This tranquil oasis boasts six shimmering infinity pools surrounded by sprawling lush gardens, a world-class onsite spa, four mouthwatering restaurants and views of some of the most spectacular sunsets in the world. Koh Samui’s flawless beaches, electrifying cuisine and inimitable hospitality make this the perfect escape for dreamers, romantics or families alike.

hotels.title: Five-Star Koh Samui Serene Seaside Stay with Spa
hotels.description: Remarkable seaside vistas meet relaxing indulgence with an escape to Choeng Mon Beach at the Kimpton Kitalay Samui, an IHG Hotel. Indulge in a luxurious treatment at the Pimãanda by HARNN or hit the beach with a kayak for some aquatic adventure. Sample and savour a diverse range of culinary delights at the five onsite restaurants, or relish an ice-cold cocktail while floating in the cool comfort of the Olympic-size swimming pool with ocean views.

hotels.title: Koh Samui Modern Oasis on Chaweng Beach with Beach Bars & Lagoon-Style Pools
hotels.description: Immerse yourself in the tropical allure of Koh Samui at this stunning beachfront property. Nestled in the lively heart of Chaweng, this modern retreat offers easy access to the city’s most picturesque attractions. Savour a delicious burger at the onsite Cielo Restaurant or explore local flavours at Baantana Thai. Enjoy exotic cocktails at the Cape Diem Beach Bar along with delectable snacks, or relax on the beach for sun-soaked moments. Put on your explorer’s hat and wander through the bustling night markets, treat yourself to a traditional Thai massage at a nearby spa or take a stroll to the pristine Chaweng Beach. For a touch of culture, visit the magnificent Big Buddha Temple, just a short drive away.

hotels.title: Koh Samui Beachfront Indulgence with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
hotels.description: Find island paradise on your doorstep at Nora Buri Resort & Spa Koh Samui, an ocean-facing gem shouldered by lush gardens and the white sands of Chaweng Beach. This resort complex is a sanctuary for the senses, offering the unparalleled tranquillity of two pools - one perched on the hillside and the other kissing the ocean's shore. For a relaxing moment between meals, The Anodas Spa boasts treatment rooms with views of Koh Samui's lush terrain. Later, enjoy dinner at The Barge, the perfect spot for catching iconic Samui sunsets, before unwinding with icy cocktails at the Lobby Bar or during happy hour by the pool. When the allure of Koh Samui pulls you away from the resort, explore the bustling eateries and markets of Fisherman's Village or the sumptuous restaurants and enticing beaches of nearby Chaweng.

hotels.title: Serene OUTRIGGER Koh Samui Five-Star Beachfront Retreat on Lamai Beach
hotels.description: Discover a captivating blend of old-world charm and tropical tranquillity with a stay at OUTRIGGER Koh Samui Beach Resort, set back on the shores of Lamai Beach. This resort brings Outrigger’s iconic reputation for top-notch hospitality to soulful Koh Samui. Savour days spent lazing by shimmering lagoon pools or sipping cocktails on warm sands at the Edgewater Beach Club.

hotels.title: Award-Winning Five-Star Koh Samui Beachfront Escape
hotels.description: Experience Koh Samui's chilled vibes and discover one of the island’s most popular beaches with a sun-kissed escape at SALA Samui Chaweng Beach Resort. Find blissful seclusion at this award-winning, contemporary resort, nestled mere steps from Chaweng's white sand and clear blue waters. Expect nothing but luxury and sweeping views over the Gulf of Thailand from this five-star beachfront oasis, consisting of two interconnecting resorts. From the impeccable facilities - which include a blissful spa and an open-air beachfront restaurant serving Thai and international cuisine - to the lavishly designed and decorated rooms, this designer resort brings another level of luxury to the shores of Chaweng. Whether you are happy chilling by the moon-shaped pool, sipping cocktails at the beachfront bar or want to explore the island, SALA Samui Chaweng Beach Resort is the ultimate base on Koh Samui.

hotels.title: Five-Star Koh Samui Beachfront Escape with Upscale Rooms & Infinity Pool
hotels.description: Discover Koh Samui's laidback island lifestyle at SALA Samui Choengmon Beach Resort. Overlooking Choeng Mon, one of the most pristine beaches on the island, this five-star resort promises sophisticated luxury. Enjoy panoramic views of the Gulf of Thailand, explore the spectacular sandy beaches dotted with tropical greenery and calm blue seas, lounge by the infinity pool with a refreshing drink or relax in your tastefully designed room or villa. Enjoy beachfront dining at the al fresco SALA Samui Restaurant, a magical dining space set just metres from the shores of Choeng Mon Beach. Explore the exciting world of Thai and international flavours here, and enjoy your favourite tipples in the casual and relaxed SALA Samui Bar. What's a Thailand vacation without a massage or two? Head to the resort's extensive SALA Spa, where you can take your first step into the wellness journey. When you're feeling active, enjoy daily complimentary yoga classes and complimentary use of kayaks and paddleboards.

hotels.title: Koh Samui Private Pool Villa Clifftop Escape with Daily Breakfast & Airport Transfers
hotels.description: Embrace the chilled-out vibes of Koh Samui and live it up in true five-star luxury with a villa escape at the clifftop playground of Samujana Villas. Feel like a celebrity staying in one of the resort’s architect-designed villas, all complete with Insta-worthy infinity pools, breathtaking views and inviting open-air living areas. Ideally positioned on a cliffside, granting ocean views and secluded privacy in all villas, this luxe property is what dreams are made of: with palatial villas fitted with lavish facilities, daily butler service to cater for every whim, delicious in-villa dining, a semi-private beach and a blissful spa, you may never want to leave this paradise. This luxurious oasis is also a short drive to a plethora of Koh Samui's most popular bars, restaurants and shops. You’ll also find yourself just a short drive away from Choeng Mon Beach - one of Koh Samui best beaches.

hotels.title: Koh Samui Award-Winning Clifftop Pool Villas with In-Villa Banquet, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Cocktails
hotels.description: Escape to clifftop luxury at Samujana Villas, an exclusive award-winning collection of 23 spectacular pool villas perched above the Gulf of Thailand. Featured in season three of HBO’s ‘The White Lotus’, this hillside sanctuary is made for indulgence - think breathtaking ocean views from your private oversized infinity pool, spacious indoor-outdoor living areas and your own dedicated villa manager to take care of every detail. Winner of the prestigious Condé Nast Johansens 2026 Readers' Award, Samujana Villas invites you to spend your days soaking up the sunshine or entertaining in style with expansive dining spaces, fully equipped kitchens and the latest in-villa entertainment systems. Savour chef-prepared meals, unwind with blissful in-villa spa treatments and let your in-villa attendant handle the rest - you'll never have to lift a finger. Perfect for families or groups of friends, some villas can accommodate up to 11 guests. Enjoy access to a range of on-site activities, including tennis, yoga and Muay Thai boxing classes, while windsurfing and diving are available nearby. When you’re ready to explore, you’re just minutes from Koh Samui’s vibrant beach clubs, top restaurants and the golden sands of Choeng Mon Beach - one of the island’s finest. This is Koh Samui at its most luxurious.

hotels.title: Five-Star Koh Samui Oceanfront Luxury with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Rooftop Cocktails
hotels.description: Paradise awaits at the breathtaking Silavadee Pool Spa Resort, built high up on the coastal cliffs overlooking Laem Nan Beach on Koh Samui. Spend balmy days sipping cocktails by the pool while looking out onto jaw-dropping panoramas of the Gulf of Thailand - pure bliss. Two unique onsite restaurants boast these same glorious views while serving up exquisite meals showcasing the flavours of the region. This resort is the perfect relaxation remedy: treat yourself to an indulgent massage at the Silavadee Spa after a long flight before ordering a lavish cocktail at Star rooftop bar at sunset for a truly unforgettable night in. Enjoy luxurious seclusion at Silavadee Pool Spa Resort, set away from the hustle and bustle of Koh Samui’s town centre. A private beach is available exclusively for resort use, which means you can experience some of the island’s best snorkelling away from the crowds. And when you’re ready to venture down from the clifftops and back into civilisation, the town is only a five-minute shuttle bus ride away. **Luxury Escapes inclusions (select nights):** - Wake up to a delicious **daily buffet breakfast** at Moon restaurant - Toast your escape in paradise with a **daily cocktail each** at Star rooftop bar - Enjoy **one signature three-course dinner** for two at Moon or The Height (for stays of 3+ nights) - Convenient **roundtrip airport transfers** in an air-conditioned vehicle (for stays of 3+ nights) - Relax with **one 45-minute foot or head-and-shoulder massage** each (for stays of 5+ nights) **Pool Villa Upgrades available**: Wake up to glorious ocean views from your plush king bed before slipping into a private infinity pool to while away an afternoon in paradise. Please refer to Fine Print for details of renovation works taking place until February 2025.

hotels.title: Koh Samui Five-Star Oceanfront Haven with Clifftop Restaurant & Horizon-Facing Infinity Pool
hotels.description: Lose yourself in stunning panoramas of the Gulf of Thailand from the five-star Six Senses Samui, where a unique location on a sloping headland at the northern tip of the island makes for jaw-dropping ocean views. Take a dip in the horizon-edged infinity pool and spend days on the beach enjoying a variety of watersports. Dine at great heights at Dining on the Rocks, an alfresco restaurant placed on the tip of the headland overlooking the ocean, or head to Drift at the Beach, the new beach bar and poolside lounge, for cocktails and bites. After all that wining and dining, succumb to pampering at the spa and wellness centre, where you can enjoy relaxing treatments like massages and facials, unwind with a steam or sauna session, join a yoga class or try your hand at meditation.
